subject: Login API returns 500 on empty password
description: POST /api/login crashes the backend with NullPointerException when the password field is an empty string instead of returning 400. Reproduced on staging, affects ~5% of bot traffic.

subject: Dashboard charts flicker on dark-mode toggle
description: Switching between light and dark mode causes the Recharts SVGs in the dashboard view to re-render with a 200ms blank flash. Visible in Chrome and Firefox. Affects perceived polish but not functionality.

subject: Add CSV export button to workflow runs table
description: Users want to export the list of recent workflow runs as CSV from the runs view in the React dashboard. No backend change needed — table data is already in the React store; just need a download button and a csv-stringify helper.
